database_access: mode=ro; query_only=ON; soul_effects_dump --all through RO facade

registry_snapshot.provenance: hub build/registry.json; existing dump, not rebuilt

queries.effect_info: SELECT id,args_num,info,param,analyze,type,key FROM effect_info ORDER BY id
queries.side_effect: SELECT id,arg_count FROM side_effect ORDER BY id
queries.effect_icon: SELECT id,effect_id,pet_id,tips,args,kind,come FROM effect_icon ORDER BY effect_id,id
queries.monsters: SELECT id,name FROM monsters ORDER BY id
queries.moves: SELECT id,name,side_effect,friend_side_effect FROM moves ORDER BY id
queries.programs: SELECT * FROM custom_effect_programs ORDER BY id
queries.overrides: SELECT * FROM custom_effect_overrides ORDER BY id

entry_order: entries.jsonl has exactly one row per baseline id, in ascending id order; line = baseline ids index + 1
registration_limit: macro scan != compiler/runtime coverage; PRE_BATTLE/HOOKS declarations are recorded separately by macro; absent registry is not proof of absent behavior
